label: evaluation
design: Primary contrast: repaired beam vs repaired beam plus the allocation bundle (reserve, exact novelty, bounded generation, no spending on stale lineages), each with preserved and reset cross-cohort access. first-improvement (repaired) is a fixed reference, not tuned. Grammar, admission policy, world rules, budgets (48 credits), lifecycle and resources are identical. The design identifies the bundle's combined effect, not the effect of each guard.
